title: Just the 'Facts, Part 3
description: Just the 'Facts, Part 3 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Jerome's Bones

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to Level 3 of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill Oroks until you obtain an Artifact Chest Skeleton Key, then unlock a nearby artifact chest. Bring the first artifact you find back to Jerome's bones in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Jerome's Bones

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Just the 'Facts, Part 4

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to Level 3 of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill Oroks until you obtain an Artifact Chest Skeleton Key, then unlock a nearby artifact chest. Bring the first artifact you find back to Jerome's bones in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

I'm sorry t' say that the artifact from Level 2 of the Shadow's Embrace didn't work, but I got a feelin' that one from Level 3 will be just the ticket I need to come back to life! Go to Level 3 and kill Oroks 'til they give up another skeleton key. Open the first Artifact Chest you can get to and bring back whatever artifact is inside.

I'm sure the next artifact will get me my body back! ...I hope.

Turn-in:

I ain't givin' up yet, kid. Bring that mystical artifact over here and res me! Dagnabbit! That one didn't work either!

Objectives:

  • Retrieve Mystical Artifact ×1

Client level range: 46–100
